decode_binary_values: decode binary series values using hex or base64 encoding with optional strict error handling
encode_binary_to_string: encode binary series values to hex or base64 string representation
test_contains_prefix_suffix: test binary series contains, starts_with, and ends_with substring matching methods
slice_and_extract_bytes: slice binary series with offset and length, or extract head and tail bytes
reinterpret_binary_as_dtype: reinterpret binary bytes as another numeric or temporal dtype with specified endianness
